messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired INC-8792 (P1) — inference-pod us-west-2 high error-rate. Pager: oncall-sre.
triage-bot: auto-triage started — hitting 502s from model-serving proxy, rate spike on queue-processor. Suggested play: run quick health checks and isolate region.
maria: ack — I'm on it, grabbing logs and checking dashboards. ETA 2m.
kevin: ack (on call) — if you need me to jump onto a bridge say so. On mobile atm.
ashley: +1 monitoring customer-impact, will start a query for 5xx by customer_id.
maria: quick findings — kubernetes liveness probes for pods in inference-pool-2 are flapping, cpu pressure noted. Logs show repeated OOMKill around pod start. snippet:```[2026-03-14T12:03:05Z] pod/inference-7f8b OOMKilled
[2026-03-14T12:03:06Z] kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 2345 (transformer)```.
kevin: can you run `kubectl get pods -n infra | grep inference-pool-2` and paste?
maria: paste:```inference-7f8b   0/1   CrashLoopBackOff   5   3m
inference-9c1a   1/1   Running            12d
inference-b2d4   0/1   CrashLoopBackOff   3   1m```
ashley: customer-impact quick take: ~3.2% of production requests in us-west-2 getting 502/5xx in last 10m. Top affected customer_org: org-214 (about 28% of failed requests). Not wide total but significant for that org.
oncall-sre: calling out cadence: if this is a capacity vs regression question we should prioritize rollback vs scale. Any recent deploys to that pool?
maria: no deploys in the pool in last 45m per deploy-bot. Could be config change or memory leak in latest model shard. I'll dump container env and image: `image: redwood/model-serving:v1.9.3`, env: `MODEL_QUANT=fp16`.
kevin: v1.9.3 was promoted yesterday to dedicated pools; we should check if that image had memory regressions. Ashley can you check metrics for RSS by process across restarts?
ashley: running query... `sum by (pod) (avg_over_time(process_resident_memory_bytes[5m]))` — seeing rising trend on the crashing pods to ~2.1GiB right before OOM. Other stable pods sit ~1.4GiB.
maria: mitigation proposal: 1) scale up pool nodes temporarily, 2) cordon flapping nodes, 3) if repro quick rollback to v1.9.2 for failing nodes. Thoughts?
kevin: prefer scale+cordon first to reduce customer impact quickly. Rolling rollback only if scale/evict doesn't hold. I'll trigger node autoscale and annotate action.
oncall-sre: actioning: `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group infra-inference-usw2 --desired-capacity 12` (was 8).
maria: doing cordon/drain on failing node ip-10-2-34-11: `kubectl cordon ip-10-2-34-11 && kubectl drain ip-10-2-34-11 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — draining now.
triage-bot: autoscale event acknowledged; new instances provisioning (~3–5m).
ashley: starting a targeted rate-limit for org-214 at edge to limit error amplification while we stabilize. Patch: `edge-route: org-214 -> rate_limit: 70%`
kevin: good temporary throttling. Maria pls watch crashloop count and pod restarts. If restarts drop below 2 in 5m, we can unthrottle.
maria: after node drain and autoscale, new pods scheduling. current failures dropping: CrashLoopBackOff count went from 6 -> 2 in last 4m. Error-rate in region down to 1.1% in tail.
ashley: customer-impact update: org-214 errors reduced by ~75% since throttling and autoscale. Notifying account team to heads-up.
oncall-sre: do we want to initiate full rollback of image v1.9.3 for that node pool?
kevin: hold for 15m while we collect mem profile and logs from stable pods. If OOMs persist after scale, rollback. Maria, can you capture heap/mem profile (`gcore` or pmap`) before we evict remaining flappers?
maria: putting a quick profiler on one stable replica now, will attach. Also uploading collected logs to s3: s3://redwood-incident/INC-8792/logs.tar.gz
triage-bot: incident severity remains P1 — customer-impact partial, mitigations in flight. Recommended postmortem mode on after stabilization.
maria: handing off for long-running follow-up to kevin — I'm going offline for scheduled appointment in 8m. Kevin, you own timeline and postmortem. Docs: runbook link https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-oom.md
kevin: taking over — I'll create an incident bridge in 5m and start a memory bisection if we see continued OOMs. tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-ml for investigation.
maria: thanks — leaving logs and steps in the incident page. :thumbsup:
kevin: status ping in 10m or earlier if regressions.
triage-bot: last automated note: incident metrics snapshot saved, alert suppressed for next 10m while autoscale completes.
pagerbot: PagerDuty INC-8792 ack by kevin at 2381400065.
kevin: closing loop for now — evident mitigation is holding. Will reopen if errors cross threshold again. Follow-up: postmortem + timeline + regression tests.
